thread:
customer_acme_jane: Hi team — our chat UI playing SSE behind Cloudflare + ALB drops the last event after ~30s of silence. Browser reconnects and users sometimes see truncated assistant text; we also get duplicate billing hits. Any pointers?

sara_support: Sorry to hear that. Quick Qs: what protocol does the browser use to Cloudflare and CF to ALB? Any proxies (nginx/Envoy) in the origin path? Can you share a curl repro?

customer_acme_jane: Flow is browser (h2) -> Cloudflare (proxy) -> ALB (front) -> k8s nginx ingress -> pod. ALB->pod is http/1.1. Repro with curl: `curl -v -N --http2 https://our-app/stream -H "Accept: text/event-stream"` then server does `printf "data: a\n\n" && sleep 35 && printf "data: final part\n\n"` and the client sees the final event cut mid-line.

eli_sre: Sounds like an idle/half-close issue. ALB backend connections are HTTP/1.1 and may coalesce or half-close on idle probes. Cloudflare can also enforce origin timeouts. If the origin pauses > tcp keepalive/idle probe window, proxies may send FIN and the client receives truncated data. Do you send periodic heartbeats?

mira_eng: Checklist: disable buffering at each proxy hop, ensure chunked transfer, and emit heartbeat bytes often. With nginx ingress set `proxy_buffering off; proxy_request_buffering off; proxy_http_version 1.1; chunked_transfer_encoding on;` and add `X-Accel-Buffering: no` on responses. For ALB, increase idle timeout for streaming listeners (>60s). For Cloudflare, enable origin keepalive or use a Worker proxy to pass through streaming.

juan_platform: Also verify your app runtime flushes on each write (some frameworks buffer). In Node: `res.write('\ndata: .\n\n'); res.flushHeaders();` in Python: `resp.write(b"\ndata: .\n\n"); await resp.drain()`; ensure no per-request `Content-Length`.

sara_support: The duplicate billing is because reconnect triggers a new request counted by billing. Recommend short resume tokens or detect replay on server. We'll loop in billing to mark duplicates while you test.

customer_acme_jane: Tried nginx ingress patch and added 10s heartbeat. ALB idle bumped to 120s. Most truncations stopped but had one case yesterday where client retried and we saw double-count.

eli_sre: If it reoccurs, capture full request/response byte logs at the pod + nginx access logs and Cloudflare/ALB logs with timestamps. That will show whether origin sent the bytes and where they were dropped. If you can, do a tcpdump on the node to show FIN sequence.

ops_jon: tagging infra for ALB/CF log pulls when customer posts timestamps: @eli_sre @juan_platform

mira_eng: We'll prepare a KB with ingress snippets, curl repro, ALB/CF notes, and billing mitigation suggestions. If needed we can escalate to AWS/Cloudflare with traces.

customer_acme_jane: Thanks — fixes looks promising. Will post logs if we see another truncation.
